parsed.name: SQLite CAN消息读取器
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于从简单的 SQLite/SQL 数据库中读取已记录的 CAN 总线消息。它适合实验中的总线通信数据回放、离线分析与日志检查，不直接控制任何实际仪器。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for reading recorded CAN bus messages from a simple SQLite/SQL database. It is used for experiment data replay, offline analysis, and log inspection, and does not directly control any physical instrument.

actions.description: 读取数据库中的全部 CAN 消息。
actions.description_en: Read all CAN messages from the database.
